title: Specification Primitive
description: A design specification produced by brainstorm mode or grill sessions. Defines what to build, not how. Stored in .specify/specs/<NAME>/spec.md or docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md.

purpose.description: What changes for the user? What does success look like?

constraints.description: Performance, security, deadlines, budgets, compatibility requirements.
constraints.shape: array of { category: string, requirement: string }

architecture.description: Components, boundaries, data flow, cardinality between entities.

shape.components: array of { name: string, responsibility: string, boundaries: string[] }
shape.dataFlow: description of how data moves between components
shape.cardinality: array of { entityA: string, relationship: string, entityB: string }

failureModes.shape: array of { scenario: string, impact: string, mitigation: string }

testing.description: What proves correctness. The first failing test you'd write.
testing.shape: array of { test: string, proves: string }

migration.description: How this ships without breaking prod.
migration.shape: array of { step: string, rollback: string }

reversibility.description: What does 'back out' look like if it goes wrong?

validationRules.allRequiredSectionsPresent: purpose, scope, architecture, and failureModes must all be non-empty
validationRules.scopeIsExhaustive: in + out + deferred must cover the full problem space — nothing unaddressed
validationRules.failureModesNonTrivial: at least one failure mode beyond 'the whole thing crashes'
validationRules.alternativesAcknowledged: if alternatives were discussed, the rejected ones must appear in an alternatives section
